title: Support correspondence for binary multi-indices
statement: For each natural number $n$, the map sending a function $a\colon\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\{0,1\}$ to the set of coordinates where it equals $1$ is an equivalence between such functions and subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$.
